scope: Read all 124 identifier/title/creator rows from the previously saved Community Audio query, then four selected item records. This is not a provenance review of all 124 recordings.

items.finding: Description advertises master-quality WAV on a separate label site, but the 25 original audio entries in this Archive item are 64-kbps MP3. The external WAV label does not qualify these files or prove that external masters are accessible and cleared.
items.disposition: Archive item cannot supply clean negatives; external master chain and access remain unverified

items.finding: Two original FLAC recordings, tagged CC BY-NC 4.0. Description explicitly says the synthesizer was recorded to MiniDisc; the recording mode and codec are not supplied.
items.disposition: Unresolved potentially lossy stage; not a qualified clean negative. FLAC distribution cannot resolve MiniDisc history.

items.finding: 21 original FLAC entries and a CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 tag. Uploader describes microphones, the band's mixer digital interface, Ardour 9 recording and a later remix from stems. Artist page confirms the May 12 event and describes an open community band, not a fixed complete personnel roster.
items.disposition: Stronger live-music lead; confirm complete work selection, capture/export details, licensor authority and the full performance personnel/lineage before admission. Do not count its 21 files as independent groups.
items.event_page_read: failed; no conclusion from the failed fetch

items.finding: One original WAVE entry, tagged CC BY-NC-ND 3.0. Description calls this a DJ set recorded from software output; upstream source-track histories are unspecified.
items.disposition: Not a qualified negative: direct output capture does not establish the history of DJ source tracks. Derivative-use conditions also remain unresolved.

medleydb_access_followup.finding: Both official full-audio records explicitly restrict files and require an access request. Public metadata remains accessible. The dataset site also documents edited timing, remixes and added/recombined content, so the delivered WAV format alone is not a clean-history label.
medleydb_access_followup.action: No login, access request, outreach or audio download; do not route around restricted files.

next_actions: Continue recording-level source and historical identity qualification; treat live-only coverage separately from studio finished-music coverage
Keep the Trolley Barn and Michael Garfield leads open without assuming independence or relaxing allocation minima
